name: omnitiler-kwin
description: KWin scripting component for OmniTiler. Development-only toolchain; KWin executes only the generated non-module bundle.

scripts.test: npm run build && rm -rf dist/tests && esbuild "tests/*.test.ts" --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --target=es2020 --define:__OMNITILER_TRACE__='"1"' --outdir=dist/tests && TRAY_BRIDGE_FIXTURE=../test-fixtures/tray-bridge-v2.json node --test "dist/tests/**/*.test.js"
